description: Imperative one-shot action that condemns a specific host in an NC2 cluster (mark it for removal). Wraps POST /clusters/{id}/condemn-host. Async: the response includes a task id which the provider polls to completion before returning the result.

host_id.description: UUID of the cluster host to condemn.

result.description: Structured outcome of the action invocation, including the polled NC2 task identifier and any error fields if the task did not complete with status `done`.

behavioral_invariants.description: The action's `result` attribute MUST surface task_id, status, http_status, error_code, and error_message so downstream Terraform code can reference them.
The Invoke operation emits exactly one tflog audit record with terraform_op = 'nc2_cluster_condemn_host.Invoke' for the action POST itself, plus additional audit records for each task-poll call.
Given an applied cluster, When the user invokes this action with a host_id, Then the provider calls /condemn-host and reports task success or failure.
